text: so why do i have 67 materials but only like 11 choices here in the building mode
resolution: Explained and fixed the material count mismatch in Buildings: the Materials workspace roster includes shader recipe rows, React texture rows, saved material rows, plus authoring-only decal rows, while Buildings was wired through a narrower flat material surface. Added a live assignable material catalog for Buildings that includes shader recipes, facade React textures, and stored shader/decal materials with source groups, then changed the building material browser to show grouped sections and filtered/total assignable counts so the full catalog is visible and searchable.
